text:
Turn every patient enquiry
into a booked appointment
AI voice receptionist, WhatsApp booking, web booking and one staff workspace
Built to extend into a complete HMS

Open with the business outcome: more enquiries converted into confirmed appointments.
Position the HMS as the expansion path after the patient acquisition layer is stable.

title: The patient journey breaks before care begins

text: The patient journey breaks before care begins
Hospitals lose demand when phone, WhatsApp and website enquiries operate as separate queues.
Calls arrive when reception is busy
Website forms do not see live schedules
Channel activity is hard to measure
No shared view of demand and conversion
The first goal is simple: answer faster, show real availability and confirm the booking in the same interaction.

Avoid claiming a current loss percentage unless the hospital supplies data.
Ask where most enquiries currently arrive and when reception pressure peaks.
Four entry points connect to the same appointment workflow.
Every confirmed appointment appears in the hospital workspace.

Stress that the channels do not maintain separate calendars.
A single booking engine reduces double handling and supports consistent reporting.

title: A shorter path from enquiry to appointment

text: A shorter path from enquiry to appointment
The system keeps the patient in the same channel while the hospital retains control.
Slot holds prevent duplicate booking. Tenant isolation separates hospital data. Staff can review channel history and intervene when needed.

Walk through one example: a caller asks for a cardiology appointment, hears available slots and confirms without waiting for reception.
Mention that staff remain able to review and correct exceptions.
A dedicated hospital front desk that can answer, check availability and complete bookings.
Review outcomes and recordings where consent permits
Holds and confirms the selected slot
Reception handles sensitive or unclear cases
Separate credentials, database and audit boundary
Activation requires the hospital’s approved phone and provider setup.

Demo the assigned number and call history if available.
Do not promise medical advice. Keep the voice agent focused on front desk information and appointments.
A guided conversation can turn a message into a confirmed appointment, with staff handoff when needed.
I need a skin specialist tomorrow
Dr Meera has 10:30 AM and 12:00 PM available.
Please confirm the patient name and booking consent.
Uses the same doctor schedules as voice and web
Collects the details required before booking
Stops automation when the patient asks for staff
Meta account, number and templates require approval

Frame WhatsApp as a guided booking journey, not an open-ended medical chatbot.
Provider activation depends on the hospital’s Meta Business and phone-number readiness.

title: One workspace for reception and management

text: One workspace for reception and management
Bookings from every channel arrive in the same operational view.
Book, reschedule, cancel and check in
Designed for hospital roles and permissions

The dashboard becomes the hospital’s operational source of truth for appointments.
Role-based access limits what front desk, clinicians and administrators can see or change.

title: Phase 2: expand into the complete HMS

text: Phase 2: expand into the complete HMS
The acquisition layer becomes the digital front door for a broader hospital operating system.
Scope, workflow and rollout sequence will be agreed with hospital leadership before Phase 2.

Separate what exists now from what follows later.
Use Phase 1 operating data and staff feedback to prioritise the HMS rollout.

title: A controlled rollout around one pilot facility

text: A controlled rollout around one pilot facility
Each stage has a clear operational owner and acceptance check.
Confirm departments, doctors, schedules, FAQs and escalation rules
Brand the website, connect channels and train the receptionist agent
Launch with selected departments, monitor bookings and support staff
Add departments and channels, then begin the agreed HMS roadmap
Enquiries answered  •  confirmed bookings  •  time to confirmation  •  staff interventions  •  patient drop-off

Do not commit dates before confirming integrations, data readiness and approval owners.
Recommend one facility or department first so both teams can validate the patient journey quickly.
Approve a focused patient acquisition pilot
Launch the channels that matter most, measure conversion, and use the same platform as the foundation for HMS expansion.
Voice, WhatsApp, web and staff desk
Decision for tomorrow: nominate the pilot facility, operational owner and preferred first channel.

Close by asking for a pilot sponsor and a working session with reception and IT.
Offer a short demonstration of voice, web booking and the staff workspace after the discussion.
